capabilities: Look up definitions of selected words in a sidebar view
Show a synonym popover for words
Look up words from right-click menus on desktop and mobile
Save lookup history to a note formatted for Obsidian Spaced Repetition flashcards
Configure dictionary API providers and offline English/Chinese lookup
extras: Installable via BRAT or manual download; offline dictionary for English and Chinese is experimental and downloads about 35 MB on first use, so the first lookup needs internet; lookups rely on third-party APIs chosen in settings; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This is an AGPL-licensed enhancement of phibr0/obsidian-dictionary
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dictionary, so users must leave the app or manually record word definitions and synonyms.

relations.evidence: This is an AGPL-licensed enhancement of phibr0/obsidian-dictionary
each unique word is written in the single-line format used by the Obsidian Spaced Repetition plugin
Reading view links and PDF++ selections support right-click lookup

summary: Dictionary lookup plugin that defines and finds synonyms for selected words via a sidebar view, right-click menus, and a flashcard-ready lookup history note.
